title: ESA Hera mission to arrive at Dimorphos asteroid in November
excerpt: The mission will conduct a survey of the asteroid to study the effects of the 2022 DART impact.
bodyHtml:
The European Space Agency announced on November 3, 2026, that its Hera spacecraft is scheduled to arrive at the Dimorphos asteroid during November. Hera is the European Space Agency’s first mission for planetary defence.

The spacecraft is headed to the 151-m-diameter Dimorphos asteroid, which orbits its 780-m Didymos parent. Dimorphos is the first object in the Solar System to have had its orbit changed by human action, following the impact of NASA’s DART spacecraft on 26 September 2022.

While DART’s impact caused a brightening visible from Earth, the physical effect on Dimorphos remains unknown. Hera will perform a close-up crash site survey to help turn the kinetic impact experiment into a well understood planetary defence deflection technique. The mission will also explore 10 asteroid mysteries, as past spacecraft close encounters have revealed asteroids to be dynamic environments with complex histories.
